summary: H2H enrichment feature: 8/8 backend contract tests PASS and the deep-dive H2HPanel renders with the correct light-amber theme (rgb(254,243,199) bg, rgb(0,0,0) text) and shows the graceful empty-state copy without white-screening. HOWEVER, a CRITICAL data bug was found: `h2h_summary` is populated on 0/68 MLB picks and 0/777 Soccer picks in /api/picks/today. Root cause: services/h2h_enricher.py:_team_h2h_from_settled parses `final_score` with regex `^\d+[-:]\d+$` but the DB stores final_score as a DICT (Soccer: {'Jaro':'2','SJK Seinäjoki':'1'}; MLB: prop-keyed {'Michael King Strikeouts':7.0,'Line':4.5}). Regex never matches → home_wins=away_wins=0 → _build_summary suppresses the chip. Result: the compact chip UX is completely non-functional, and by extension the LockPickCard chip (h2h-chip) and why-block (h2h-why-block) cannot render on any pick. Secondary bug: Tennis /api/picks/{id}/h2h returns ok=true but summary='' — likely a name-format mismatch between short pick selection ('Bublik A.') and full names in tennis_matches_history ('Grigor Dimitrov'). Deep-dive panel + endpoint contract are correct; frontend is coded correctly. Backend enricher needs fixing.

critical.issue: final_score in DB is a dict (Soccer team-keyed: {'Jaro':'2','SJK Seinäjoki':'1'}; MLB prop-keyed: {'Michael King Strikeouts':7.0,'Line':4.5}). Enricher does `str(final_score)` and regex-matches ^\d+[-:]\d+$ — NEVER matches → home_wins/away_wins always 0 → _build_summary always returns '' → h2h_summary attached on 0/68 MLB, 0/777 Soccer picks. The compact chip feature is dead on arrival.

Returns ok=true but summary='' on tested tennis pick. Pick.selection uses short-format names ('Bublik A.') while tennis_matches_history.winner_name uses full names ('Grigor Dimitrov'). services/tennis/fallback.get_h2h name matching likely fails on this format mismatch.

minor.issue: MLB player H2H is scoped to markets containing 'strikeout|outs recorded|walks|earned runs' — but MLB has HR/hits/hitter props too. Hitter-prop picks will never get a player_h2h even on the deep-dive endpoint.

When bundle is empty the endpoint returns ok=false but the shape still includes sport/summary/team_h2h/player_h2h/situational/sources — good, but 'error' key is only present when an actual exception is caught. Consider a 'reason' field for the empty-bundle case for consistency.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be visually verified because backend never populates pick.h2h_summary (see CRITICAL backend bug). Frontend code is coded to render conditionally so this is not a frontend bug per se — once the backend is fixed re-verify.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): services/h2h_enricher.py:_team_h2h_from_settled must parse the dict shape of `final_score`. For Soccer rows with team-keyed dicts ({home_name: 'N', away_name: 'M'}), extract wins directly. For MLB rows where final_score is prop-keyed (no game score at all), skip win-tallying but still count the meeting, OR (better) source game scores from a separate collection (mlb_games / mlb_boxscores) if available. Without this fix h2h_summary is never emitted.

FIX (HIGH): Tennis H2H — normalise selection names ('Bublik A.') to the fully-qualified form used in tennis_matches_history ('Alexander Bublik') before calling services.tennis.fallback.get_h2h. Add a lookup in tennis_players or map short-form → full-form.
FOLLOW-UP: Expand _mlb_player_h2h market whitelist to include hitter-prop markets (hits, home_runs, total_bases, RBIs) OR gate the pitcher-only whitelist on prop_type instead of substring match.
AFTER BACKEND FIX: Re-run this test file (test_iter86_h2h_enrichment.py) and Playwright to verify h2h-chip renders on at least one LockPickCard and h2h-why-block appears on expand.
critical_code_review_comments: h2h_enricher.py:141 — regex `^\s*(\d+)\s*[-:]\s*(\d+)\s*$` on str(final_score) will match `"{'Jaro': '2'"...` as False. This is the entire root cause of the dead chip. Move to a schema-aware parser that inspects the dict shape.

h2h_enricher.py:60 _cache_key includes `sport|home|away|selection|market` — the cache is per-selection/market. That's correct, but note the 6h TTL means the CRITICAL bug's empty result will be sticky in-process for 6h after any startup. Backend restart flushes the process cache; keep that in mind while iterating.

picks_routes.py:2205 — the h2h attach loop runs `await build_h2h_bundle(db, _slim, fast_mode=True)` inside a sync-looking `for _slim in canonical` — this is fine because we're already inside an async endpoint, but the 200-item budget hits ~200 sequential await/Mongo hops. For a 777-pick Soccer response this contributes ~50-70ms/pick × 200 ≈ 10-14s if data existed. Currently unnoticed because every call returns None almost immediately. Post-fix, consider asyncio.gather-batching in groups of 20.

success_rate.backend: 8/8 endpoint contract tests pass, but feature is functionally broken: 0/845 picks emit h2h_summary
success_rate.frontend: H2HPanel deep-dive renders correctly (theme + empty-state); chip/why-block not testable due to backend data bug

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: services/h2h_enricher.py:_team_h2h_from_settled (lines 130-171) treats the settled pick's `final_score` field as a plain string ('3-2') and matches it with regex `^\d+[-:]\d+$`. Empirical DB inspection shows final_score is stored as a DICT in every settled row: Soccer team-keyed like {'Jaro':'2','SJK Seinäjoki':'1'} and MLB prop-keyed like {'Michael King Strikeouts':7.0,'Line':4.5}. `str({...})` never matches the regex, so home_wins and away_wins stay 0 across all meetings. _build_summary (line 358-365) requires hw+aw > 0 before emitting the team-H2H chip, so summary is always ''. Since /picks/today only attaches h2h_summary when non-empty (picks_routes.py:2225), no pick ever carries the field. Frontend LockPickCard renders the chip conditionally on h2h_summary — hence 0 chips on the entire slate. REPRO: (1) call GET /api/picks/today?sport=Soccer as demo user, count picks where h2h_summary is truthy → returns 0 out of 777. (2) MongoDB query: db.picks.countDocuments({sport:'MLB', final_score: {$type:'string'}}) → 0; db.picks.countDocuments({sport:'MLB', final_score: {$type:'object'}}) → 2200+. MITIGATION: rewrite the parser to inspect the final_score dict — for Soccer use team_name → goals mapping, for MLB use a separate mlb_games collection or a game-scores field if one exists. Until then the chip UX is a no-op.
